evidence: go test ./internal/scoring/anthropic -run ZZ -v (httptest server returning usage output_tokens=1000, output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens=600, model claude-opus-4-8) -> "OutputTokens=1000 ThinkingTokens=0 CostUSD=0.0250 (... with thinking added separately = 0.0400)"
notes: The thinking cost is not excluded. anthropic-sdk-go v1.58.0's OutputTokensDetails doc says thinking_tokens is 'Always <= output_tokens', so it is already billed inside OutputTokens. Following the suggestion would double-count via CostUSD (output+thinking). Unverified assumption: that the live API's output_tokens includes thinking. This rests on the SDK doc comment; no live call was made (no credentials, paid). The request also does not enable extended thinking. Weak because ThinkingTokens stays 0 for reporting purposes.
